resources.string: While a chosen app is in front
While a chosen app is open, ordinary alerts scroll by on a ribbon. Calls, alarms, and media are left alone.
Turns on by itself while a chosen app is in front. Ordinary alerts scroll by on the ribbon. Calls, alarms, and media still come through.
The switch stays off until notification access, usage access, and display over other apps are all granted.
Reads the title and text for the strip. When the notification access screen shows toggles, leave alerting, silent, and conversations on for Ribbon Notifs.
Draws the thin strip. The strip does not take taps, so the app underneath still receives every touch.
Sees which app is in front so Ribbon Notifs can turn on by itself. Without this, nothing arms automatically.
These are system settings, not one-time permission dialogs. Android can ask for them again after Ribbon Notifs sits unused for a long time.
That system screen is not available on this phone.
Allow display over other apps before previewing the strip.
No apps chosen yet. Search to add one. Tap a chosen app to remove it.
Ribbon Notifs: This is a preview ribbon notification. Adjust the size, scrolling speed and background to preview. This is what it looks like across the screen.
